name: OEM maintenance schedule by vehicle model and year, sourced from the manufacturer's own document
description: What the manufacturer's own maintenance guide says to do at each mileage/time interval, one record per make, model, model year, interval and service item, each quoted from the manufacturer's own PDF. Toyota publishes a Maintenance Guide/Owner's Manual Supplement per model year at assets.sia.toyota.com; the Sequoia Hybrid 2026 and Camry 2024 guides are covered here, including the Special Operating Conditions schedule and the condition each of those items applies under.
licence: Facts taken from Toyota's own published Maintenance Guide/Owner's Manual Supplement PDFs, one short verbatim quote per record with a link back to the PDF. No page, chart or table is reproduced in full; each record is one line item's own words, not the assembled chart. Facts are not copyrightable (Feist, 1991); what is taken here is a maintenance fact plus a short attributed quote linking back to Toyota's own document.
